scope: 기능 보존 UI/UX 검토 이미지. Samsung Health 내부 UI 제외. 합성 이름·본문·대화·사진 사용.
sharedDarkStyle: Use case: ui-mockup. Input is STYLE ONLY. One high fidelity FitMate Android flat screenshot, portrait 853x1844, full safe area with 9:41 status bar and Android gesture line, no phone frame or poster. Reference visual language: charcoal #1C2025 background, #282E35 surfaces, white text, gray secondary text, vivid mint #16DFC1 primary buttons with BLACK text, outlined secondary actions, simple consistent icons, sharp readable Korean. Preserve only specified existing features. No stories/reels, bookmark/share, search, AI, calls, voice, location maps, online/typing dots, stars, new tabs or invented extra counters. Only feed and DM list have the five bottom navigation tabs; all other screens have NO bottom nav. Synthetic user data. Photo when specified: small natural still life of plain black training shoes and mint water bottle on a neutral gym bench, no people or logos.
lightThemeEdit: Use case: ui-mockup. Convert supplied DARK FitMate screenshot into its exact LIGHT counterpart. Change only colors: #F6F8FA background, #FFFFFF cards/sheets, #E1E6EC borders, #182129 primary text and #5D6874 secondary text. Mint filled primary buttons/chips stay #16DFC1 with black text; mint text/icons on light surfaces become dark teal #007D70. Amber request badge pale amber/dark brown. Danger text dark red. Dark system icons/gesture bar. Preserve ALL Korean wording, values, selected states, photographs, geometry, icon arrows, buttons, navigation and source dimensions. Photos remain exactly the same unmodified. For sheets retain dimmed overlay behind the white sheet, underlying app light. No extra arrows or missing existing controls. No new features. Sharp readable Korean.
